messages:
marta: Quick planning q — can we run a "Micro Hero" recognition station at next Wed all‑hands? idea: 30 mini acrylic trophies + handwritten thank‑you cards to hand out. timeline, vendor lead time, and volunteers?
kevin: Love that. Vendor quoted 5 business days for engraving + 2 days shipping. Can we compress?
lara: We can assemble & write notes same‑day. I can coordinate volunteers for packing night. Count me in. :raised_hands:
tom: Budget check — trophies + engraving + shipping came to $430. ok to proceed?
marta: Approved from culture events budget. @finance FYI — will flag with the card. :white_check_mark:
kevin: I'll ask vendor for a proof today and check rush options. If engraving list is final by Tue morning, we can hit Wed.
lara: I can prepare a printable label template and bring the label printer. Also propose handwriting the short notes to keep it personal. Need ~6 volunteers for labeling/writing.
spot-awards-bot: Reminder: please submit final names for physical awards by EOD Tuesday so engraving can be locked in.
tom: Volunteer slots suggestion — Tue 6–8pm (packing & stuffing notes) and Wed 8:30–9:15am (set up before all‑hands). @lara @kevin @marta — who can cover?
lara: I can run Tue evening and Wed morning coordination. I'll make a signup sheet and drop it here.
marta: I'll draft the all‑hands blurb and a short nomination reminder for #general. Also will prep a 1‑liner to put at the station about what the awards represent.
kevin: Also suggest QR code at the station that links to the ongoing nomination form for next month — keeps momentum. I'll generate it once sheet is live.
marta: Great. Quick checklist to keep us aligned: vendor proof (kevin), engraving list by Tue EOD (all nominators), label template + volunteer signups (lara), announcement copy for #general (marta), finance note (tom). I'll update this thread with the signup link when ready. :sparkles:
